name: Snap-on
description: Snap-on makes premium hand and power tools, tool storage, vehicle diagnostics and repair-shop equipment, and sells them to professional mechanics, repair shops, car dealers and industrial customers such as aerospace and utilities. Its signature channel is a network of franchisees who drive vans to mechanics' workplaces weekly, selling tools, often on credit. Snap-on's own finance arm lends to those mechanics and franchisees, which is why financial services is a fifth of segment profit on under 8 percent of revenue. Repair-shop software and information (what dealers and independent shops use to fix modern cars) is its largest profit segment.
